experiment_plan.attacker_action: Grow the attacker-controlled data set or trigger repeated input processing before a victim call.
experiment_plan.expected_observation: Attacker-controlled participant set amplifies processing cost should produce progressively higher cost as attacker-controlled state expands.
experiment_plan.falsification_condition: If the victim operation remains flat or bounded despite growth in the attacker-controlled state, the hypothesis is weakened or falsified.
experiment_plan.measurement: Record gas usage and execution cost as the attacker-controlled input size increases.
experiment_plan.setup: Deploy the local contract and initialize attacker-controlled state with a small baseline.
experiment_plan.state_changes: Observe whether attacker-controlled growth causes a larger resource requirement in the victim path.
experiment_plan.victim_action: Call the relevant mutating path in addParticipant, processAll.

mechanism: A dynamic list or mapping is populated by an attacker and later processed in a loop, causing the victim operation to become more expensive as the attacker-controlled set grows.
predicted_failure: The victim operation's gas use rises with the size of the attack-controlled state and eventually becomes impractical.
required_state: participants array or mapping-backed state must contain attacker-created entries
target_invariant: One user should not be able to make another user's operation excessively expensive.
title: Attacker-controlled participant set amplifies processing cost
